column3: The Non-Serviced Special Servicer under the 1010 Pacific Street Mortgage Loan will be entitled to a workout fee equal to the lesser of (i) 1.0% of each payment (other than penalty charges) of principal and interest (other than any amount for which a liquidation fee would be paid) in respect of the 1010 Pacific Street Mortgage Loan made by the related borrower after a workout of the 1010 Pacific Street Mortgage Loan and (ii) $1,000,000. The workout fee is subject to a minimum fee of $25,000.
